fact: On 24-28 June 2019 ICPAC trained Eritrean Ministry of Land, Water and Environment staff to administer and apply a MESA station, a satellite data receiving and processing system provided to Eritrea between 2011 and 2017 (receiver sits in the environment ministry, not named as the weather service).
title: ICPAC Trains Eritrean Experts on Earth Observation Receiving Stations
